interface.title: AlphaFraud
interface.field: Structural biology / protein structure prediction benchmarking
interface.stage_of_work: Validation and critical assessment of predicted protein models against newly deposited experimental structures
interface.what_it_is_for: Compare each newly deposited human PDB structure with its blind AlphaFold DB model, then rank, chart and explain the cases where AlphaFold was confident but wrong.

data.note: The database was seeded with 9 human PDB entities (9BZS, 7U14, 7DME, 8UWB, 6YEL, 9A1Q, 6RSS, 6Q9F, 6TT5) spread over 9 release weeks. All metrics, KPIs, charts and CSV exports are populated. The 3D viewers and Cα-deviation ribbons have no structure files, so they render as blank boxes. The Analysis page has not been built. Without internet access, Calculate only works for the 9 indexed IDs.
